UK.sovereigntyDetails: UK data protection requirements include GDPR compliance and UK-specific data protection regulations. Data processors must maintain UK-based data residency for critical personal data.

Spain.sovereigntyDetails: Spain enforces strict GDPR compliance with additional requirements through LSSI-CE. EU data localization standards apply. Spanish authorities have jurisdiction over data processing.

Germany.sovereigntyDetails: Germany has stringent data protection laws including GDPR, TMG (Telemediengesetz), and NetzDG. Data must be processed in compliance with German data protection authority (BfDI) requirements.

France.sovereigntyDetails: France enforces GDPR with additional requirements through CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés). Data processing must comply with French regulatory framework and may require explicit CNIL oversight.

Italy.sovereigntyDetails: Italy requires GDPR compliance with additional provisions under Italian Data Protection Code. Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante) oversees compliance.

Netherlands.sovereigntyDetails: Netherlands enforces GDPR with Dutch-specific implementation. Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has oversight authority.

Belgium.sovereigntyDetails: Belgium enforces strict GDPR compliance through Belgian Data Protection Authority.

Poland.sovereigntyDetails: Poland enforces GDPR with Polish-specific requirements through UODO (Polish Data Protection Authority).

Sweden.sovereigntyDetails: Sweden enforces GDPR with Swedish Data Protection Authority (Datainspektionen) oversight.

Norway.sovereigntyDetails: Norway applies GDPR equivalently through the Norwegian Personal Data Act with oversight by Norwegian Data Protection Authority.

Denmark.sovereigntyDetails: Denmark enforces GDPR with Danish Data Protection Authority oversight.

Finland.sovereigntyDetails: Finland enforces GDPR with Finnish Data Protection Authority (Tietosuojavaltuutettu) oversight.

Austria.sovereigntyDetails: Austria enforces GDPR with Austrian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Ireland.sovereigntyDetails: Ireland enforces GDPR with Irish Data Protection Commission oversight.

Portugal.sovereigntyDetails: Portugal enforces GDPR with Portuguese Data Protection Commission oversight.

Greece.sovereigntyDetails: Greece enforces GDPR with Greek Data Protection Authority oversight.

Czech Republic.sovereigntyDetails: Czech Republic enforces GDPR with Czech Data Protection Authority oversight.

Hungary.sovereigntyDetails: Hungary enforces GDPR with Hungarian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Romania.sovereigntyDetails: Romania enforces GDPR with Romanian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Bulgaria.sovereigntyDetails: Bulgaria enforces GDPR with Bulgarian Data Protection Commission oversight.

Croatia.sovereigntyDetails: Croatia enforces GDPR with Croatian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Slovenia.sovereigntyDetails: Slovenia enforces GDPR with Slovenian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Slovakia.sovereigntyDetails: Slovakia enforces GDPR with Slovak Data Protection Authority oversight.

Luxembourg.sovereigntyDetails: Luxembourg enforces GDPR with Luxembourg Data Protection Commission oversight.

Malta.sovereigntyDetails: Malta enforces GDPR with Maltese Information and Data Protection Commissioner oversight.

Cyprus.sovereigntyDetails: Cyprus enforces GDPR with Cyprus Data Protection Authority oversight.

Lithuania.sovereigntyDetails: Lithuania enforces GDPR with Lithuanian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Latvia.sovereigntyDetails: Latvia enforces GDPR with Latvian Data Protection Authority oversight.

Estonia.sovereigntyDetails: Estonia enforces GDPR with Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate oversight.
